detail.message: A ativação dos plugins do OpenCode não terminou (HTTP 503).
detail.recommendation: Verifique compatibilidade e dependências dos plugins. O plugin responsável ainda não foi identificado. Não reinstale nem altere sua conta para contornar este erro.

Dismissing the explicit confirmation preserves the normal profile
Explicit isolation verifies catalogue and configured official connection without copying credentials

detail.recommendation: Selecione um modelo disponível. A presença de credencial não comprova acesso ao modelo.

checks.name: Both mandatory Go models are obtained from the authenticated catalogue
One synthetic Muse Go task executes in an explicitly identified isolated session
Independent fixture assertions pass; only the intended synthetic file changes and HEAD/index remain intact
Returning to normal affects new sessions while the existing session stays isolated
Hub crash preserves the same isolated helper/session identity without repeating its prompt
A restarted Hub defaults new sessions to the normal profile
The recovered isolated helper can be interrupted and safely closed
Synthetic workspace returns exactly to its baseline
Personal configuration and global plugin file bytes and mtimes are unchanged
Repeated diagnostic reads reuse the failed probe until an explicit retry
Final UI preserves the actual chosen Go model; capture refinement creates no new inference or session

interruptScenario: Completed isolated session: interruption request and full helper stop. Active cancellation and team correction are deterministic regressions; prior gate proved active OpenCode recovery.

packagedBrowser.name: 1. the Singularity Browser opens as an editor tab
1b. the browser presents itself as "Singularity Browser" (welcome title)
1c. no tab starts shared with an agent (sharing is an explicit per-tab opt-in)
1d. agents cannot drive browser pages by default (enableChatTools is off)
2. the address bar loads a local page (server received GET /a.html)
2b. the tab title follows the page title
3. a real mouse click on a link navigates (server received GET /b.html)
4a. Alt+Left goes back to page A
4b. Alt+Right goes forward to page B
4c. F5 reloads the page (a new request reached the server)
5a. the page cannot reach Node/Electron/VS Code APIs
5a2. the only bridge visible to the page is the helper pair (no IPC, no IDE API)
5b. the page cannot read local files through file://
5c. no GitHub credential or token reached the page
6. a second browser tab can be opened
7. the browser (left) and the editor (right) are visible side by side
8. F12 opens Developer Tools for the page
9a. Event Minimal Light applies to the browser UI
9b. Event Minimal Dark applies back
10. resizing the window re-lays out the browser without horizontal overflow
12a. regression: the integrated terminal still opens
12b. regression: the Source Control view still opens
12c. regression: the Extensions view still opens
11a. the IDE closes normally (no forced kill)
11. after closing and reopening, the browser tabs are restored
11b. the restored page loads again when its tab is shown

limits: The activation phase is confirmed; the specific plugin/dependency remains undetermined.
Isolation filters non-native namespaces by a process-only official configuration overlay; it does not repair or rewrite the personal profile.
Configured official connection metadata is not proof of remote model access. Environment declarations alone remain unverified; isolated inference is blocked without an official registered connection.
Existing inline configuration is never overwritten.

Only one real Muse Go task was required. DeepSeek Go availability was confirmed in the catalogue; team correction, active cancellation and application/rollback were regressed with local deterministic fixtures, preserving prior real E2E evidence.
The current real crash test recovered a completed isolated helper. The previous gate proved live OpenCode recovery; no prompt was restarted here.
Isolated execution currently recognises official registered OpenCode/OpenCode Go connection metadata; other integrations remain unverified in this assisted mode. Normal provider flows are unchanged.
